text: Handling deadlines well is a skill that can reduce stress and improve your work. The first step is time management: break a large project into smaller tasks and set mini-deadlines for each one. Prioritization also matters—identify which tasks are most important or urgent and do those first, even if they are not the most enjoyable. Another key is scope management; be realistic about what you can achieve in the given time, and don’t be afraid to cut unnecessary details. Finally, communication is crucial. If you see a problem early, tell your team or manager right away, rather than waiting until the last minute. Good communication often leads to helpful solutions.
